rollback.command: git revert 993c4248 and push to main
rollback.note: First R2 release; the earlier version was Hub-hosted. Reverting the migration commit redeploys the Hub-hosted version; the immutable R2 objects stay.

changes: Rewritten from the Hub-hosted legacy version into a self-contained R2 package with its own settings dialog, spotlight tutorial, results and zh/en copy; settings.json, score.json, public/runtime and the OfficialGameShell dependency are gone and the old Hub sub-assets return 410

English name Letter Memory Task -> Letter Memory; an on-screen A to Z keyboard answers (physical keys, Backspace and Enter work too) and exactly 4 letters are required; string lengths cycle 5/7/9/11 in shuffled order; neighboring letters never repeat; practice feedback shows 2 s and practice became a setting
